spec.hypothesis: Phase-gated compound sparsity effect (II_low > II_high) is robust to asymmetric head/KV sparsity configurations, not an artifact of symmetric settings
spec.description: SF5: Asymmetric sparsity spot check. 2 configs: (head=0.25,KV=0.15) and (head=0.15,KV=0.25). n=50, DeepSeek only, importance-based. 4 conditions per config: dense/head-only/KV-only/compound. Pre-registered criterion: direction consistency of D=II_low-II_high.
